records.reason: A two-action Strike-then-Grapple activity resolved entirely at the table; the flail/spiked-chain clause changes only how that Athletics check is adjudicated.
Reaction that raises a foe's flat-check DC by 2 — it modifies the enemy's roll at the table, not any statistic on the character sheet.
Grants the concealed state in natural terrain, a table-adjudicated combat condition; matches the existing Camouflage (ranger) precedent of carrying no field.
Adds the death trait to Strikes against doomed creatures and blocks resurrection — entirely target-side and GM-adjudicated.
Treats you as always Covering Tracks outside urban areas: an exploration-mode activity the app does not model.

Adds seven named spells (Shadow Blast, Shadow Siphon, Umbral Journey, Replicate, Shadow Army, Shadow Projectile, Shadow Raid) to the character's own spell list so they can be learned/prepared off-tradition. Spell pickers filter strictly by tradition and there is no spell-list-addition lane (no field, no registry) to widen that list.
Reaction to Stride along an ally's path; movement resolved at the table, no sheet statistic changes.
A three-action mounted activity; the extra 3d6/4d6/5d6 is part of that activity's own resolution in dim light, not a persistent bonus on any Strike.
Reaction forcing an enemy to reroll and take the lower result — a misfortune effect applied to the foe's roll at the table.
A one-action play-time condition-recovery activity (reduce frightened, save vs sickened); conditions are tracked in play, the action itself is resolved at the table.
A movement activity: Stride twice/thrice ignoring difficult terrain and Speed penalties, resolved at the table for that action only.

Increases the Speed of the necrologist's horde, not the player's; companionGrants.ts deliberately holds the activity-summoned horde back from the companion model, so there is no creature on the sheet to modify.
Alters the DC and critical-failure outcome of the Request skill activity, which the GM adjudicates; no sheet statistic changes.
The GM rolls a secret Perception check for you against disguised creatures — pure GM-side adjudication, no bonus to any check.
A kineticist impulse: an area-damage action resolved at the table against your class DC, which the sheet already computes.
Reaction that redirects a curse or misfortune effect from an ally onto you; the effect itself is applied at the table.

Lets the summoner cast the eidolon's innate spells from Magical Understudy/Adept/Master (shared daily uses). No eidolon innate-spellcasting lane exists — Magical Understudy carries no field either — so there is nothing to project onto the summoner's spell list, and innateSpells cannot express it without over-granting spells the character's actual evolution feats may not include.
Grants the effects of Rage to a willing ally; it changes only the ally's statistics.
A one-action use of Quick Tincture plus handing the item to another creature — item transfer resolved at the table.
Lets a second ally make a reactive Strike after Courageous Assault; entirely ally-side.
Redirects your terrain-attunement benefit to an ally instead of yourself; it grants the player nothing new.
Retargets Halfling Luck's reroll to an ally's failed check; the reroll is resolved at the table and benefits the ally.
A telepathic bond with an NPC student and a shared-save fortune effect that requires that second creature at the table; nothing on the character sheet changes on its own.
Extends the duration of Overdrive Ally for the targeted ally; ally-side only.
Grants your Hunt Prey benefits and hunter's edge to an ally; the player's own benefits are unchanged.
Grants Replenishment of War's temporary Hit Points to an ally instead of yourself; ally-side only.
A spellshape action that extends your existing spiritsense to allies; the player already has spiritsense from Soulsight.
Makes the struck creature off-guard to a designated ally — target/ally-side, resolved at the table.
Redirects the Dualistic Synergy benefit to an ally instead of yourself; no new player-side effect.
A Swim activity that grants allies you pass a swim Speed; the player's own swim Speed comes from the werecreature animal shape, not this feat.
A two-action Swim-and-Strike activity resolved at the table.
A Strike that inflicts off-guard on a frightened target and pins its frightened value — entirely target-side condition manipulation.
A psychic amp that replaces a psi cantrip's amp entry with an aura resolved at the table; damage scales off the cantrip's rank, which the spell already carries.
Ignores Hardness when damaging objects while raging; object Hardness is not a character statistic and is adjudicated by the GM.
A one-action activity that throws and shoots a bomb for area damage against your class DC; resolved at the table.
An unarmed Strike that bypasses the target's resistances and halves its Hardness — target-side only.
Reaction adding 3d6 damage when an improvised weapon shatters on a critical Improvised Pummel; a one-off table resolution, not a standing damage bonus.
A reaction to escape a grab; the day-long aftermath (no tail attack, -2 to Balance) is a transient self-inflicted state the player tracks in play, not a standing sheet modifier.
A 10-minute exploration activity that creates a temporary shelter; the app does not model terrain or created structures.
Prevents being off-guard from flanking while adjacent to a stone wall; flanking and the off-guard state are positional and resolved at the table, not sheet statistics.
An aura extending Survivor of Desolation to allies within 10 feet; the player already has that benefit from the prerequisite feat.
Grants a reaction resolved at the table; the shield Hardness/HP/Broken Threshold and in-play shield damage it consumes are already derived by deriveShield in src/rules/derive.ts.
Broadens what the Shield from Arrows reaction may be used against; the reaction itself is resolved at the table.
Splits post-Shield-Block damage between you and the ally you protected — an in-play damage decision at the table.
An ikon imbued into the Mirror Aegis whose content is a Transcendence action; the action is resolved at the table and the ikon subsystem already carries the imbuement.

Keeps your chosen shield permanently raised: the AC it confers is already available through the sheet's Raise a Shield mode (cat-raise-shield), and the remainder — the shield vanishing to and returning from your deity's realm — is narrative/GM-side.
Saves a shield from destruction at 1 HP during a Shield Block; an in-play item-durability outcome resolved at the table (shield damage is already tracked).
Reaction granting cover while you and an adjacent ally both have shields raised; cover is positional and resolved at the table.
Lets your Shield Block reaction protect an adjacent ally instead of you; ally-side retarget of an at-table reaction.

Increases the weapon damage die of any shield bash, shield boss, or shield spikes you wield by one step — a real, permanent damage change. Shields are modelled only as AC/Hardness/HP (deriveShield); no shield attack exists in the strikes lane and unarmedTraits.stepDie only reaches unarmed Strikes, so no field can step a shield attack's die.
A one-action Raise-a-Shield-plus-Stride activity that suppresses enemy reactions against allies; resolved at the table.
Lets you move half your Speed without triggering reactions while your shield is raised; reaction-triggering is a table adjudication, not a sheet statistic.
Fuses a shield into a book so the tome shares its Hardness/HP and can Shield Block; an equipment-form arrangement resolved at the table with the shield's own stats.
A one-action Raise a Shield plus Taunt activity; the added auditory trait applies to that action's resolution.
Moves an active spell's area and halves its remaining duration; spell areas and durations are tracked at the table.
A Stride that lets allies Step out of your space; positional and ally-side.
Modifies the target and duration of the Light spell you cast and adds a dazzle rider on an ally's critical hit; all target-side spell adjudication.
Allows sharing a square with an ally; purely positional, resolved at the table.
Lets you Sneak at full Speed near a sea vehicle; a situational Stealth-activity allowance the GM adjudicates, with no roll or statistic changed.

The feat requires the player to choose natural or urban terrain, and nothing records that pick — the sheet cannot say which terrain the character trained in. The Hide/Sneak-without-cover benefit itself is table-adjudicated, but the choice must be captured.

effectChoices.prompt: Choose the terrain for Shooter's Camouflage

options.label: Natural terrain
options.note: You can Hide and Sneak in natural terrain even without cover or being concealed.

options.label: Urban terrain
options.note: You can Hide and Sneak in urban terrain even without cover or being concealed.
